title: Engadget review recap: Apple devices, Googlebooks and Kindles

claims.claim: Engadget, son iki haftada 13 yeni inceleme yayınladı.

evidence.quote: In a fortnight, we've published 13 new reviews

claims.claim: Apple, PROLED XDR ekranlı ve dokunmatik özellikli yeni bir MacBook Pro modeli tanıttı.

evidence.quote: The main attraction is certainly the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, the first touchscreen Apple laptop with a very awkward name.

claims.claim: Yeni iPad mini, A20 Pro çip ile piyasaya sürüldü.

evidence.quote: Last but not least, deputy news editor Nathan Ingraham tested the iPad mini with an A20 Pro chip.

claims.claim: iPad mini modelinin ekran yenileme hızı 60Hz'dir ve cihazda Face ID özelliği bulunmamaktadır.

evidence.quote: But, yet again, the device is more expensive, plus the display refresh rate is still 60Hz and there's no Face ID.

claims.claim: Lenovo Googlebook 15 ve Dell XPS Googlebook modellerinin her ikisi de yaklaşık 1.000 dolar fiyat etiketine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: Senior reporter Sam Rutherford tested the Lenovo Googlebook 15 while Devindra reviewed the Dell XPS Googlebook, which both cost around $1,000.

claims.claim: Amazon, Colorsoft ve Paperwhite modellerinin Signature Edition versiyonlarını piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: Amazon has a bunch of new Kindle devices this fall, and the first two we could get our hands on were the Signature Editions of the Colorsoft and Paperwhite models.

claims.claim: Fitbit Edge, Google tarafından geliştirilen bir giyilebilir teknoloji ürünüdür.
Samsung, Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 modelini piyasaya sürmüştür.

evidence.quote: We had to wait for the most attractive new features to arrive on the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2, but as soon as Samsung delivered those, UK bureau chief Mat Smith went to work.
